+ Meet Poseidon Principles (aer) and Energy Efficiency goals (EEDI/ EEXI)

+ Econowind Flatrack unit 
The Flatrack unit is based on ISO-fix corners and can quickly be placed and removed. Giving a flexible solution for a variety of vessels such as general cargo vessels or other vessels.
